description:
Welcome to HackOdisha 6.0
A 36-hour hybrid hackathon organized by Webwiz, the official tech club of NIT Rourkela

After five successful seasons, HackOdisha returns bigger and better uniting developers and creatives from across the globe to tackle real-world challenges.

Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, if you thrive on problem‑solving and innovation, this is your arena.

You can participate solo or form a team but remember: every member must register individually to be eligible.

Join us on this journey of creativity, code, and community at HackOdisha 6.0!

hackathon_faqs.answer: It is a 36-hour online hackathon organised by Webwiz, NIT Rourkela.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is HackOdisha

hackathon_faqs.answer: Anyone interested in technology, innovation, and problem-solving can participate. Students, professionals, and enthusiasts are all welcome.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate

hackathon_faqs.answer: You can register through our official website by filling out the registration form and following the instructions provided.
hackathon_faqs.question: How do i participate

hackathon_faqs.answer: A team can have up to 5 members.
hackathon_faqs.question: How many members can form a team

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Yes! Every team member must register individually.
You can either form a team later invite others using team referral code or join one using a teammate’s referral code.
hackathon_faqs.question: Do all team members participate individually

hackathon_faqs.answer: Follow us on our social media channels for the latest updates and announcements.
hackathon_faqs.question: How can i stay updated?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You can use any technology stack you are comfortable with. We encourage creativity and innovation in your solutions.
